utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still not totally sure on the exact issue, but I can check and get back to you. The repair drive is headed to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still happening today—just let me know what you need first, and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll see you Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on today — same time, same place. I’ll spread the word if anyone’s asking.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, let’s keep it at Saturday morning and meet at the community center on Oak Street first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — so it’s Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—just let me know the schedule, and I’ll be ready in a simple, steady way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the schedule and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the exact issue and where the repair drive is headed? I want to make sure I have the details right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m in, but I still don’t have the exact issue or destination yet. Tell me when and where the repair drive is headed, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I can spread the word and I’ll bring a few tools and some supplies if I have them. Just let me know the time and place for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Jules — I’ll send you the time and place as soon as I have it. If you can, please also rally a couple more neighbors to come along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help with that, but I’d like to keep it organized — do we know what’s most urgently needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure of the exact list yet, but I’ve heard tools and basic hardware are usually the big ones. If you’ve got the details, I’d love to pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks for keeping track, Mina. Where should we start the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When and where is the repair drive? I can help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks — I’m checking what we’re short on first, and I’ll tell you the top priorities for the repair drive soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. Just send me the top priorities when you know them, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch. I’m still organizing the remaining tasks, so I’ll share what’s left shortly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—low-key is perfect. I’ll keep the repair drive simple and fit it around school pickup.
